items.speaker: NIB
items.text: Can we ask for a place that’s still open?

items.speaker: TAEO
items.text: Do you have anything current? From a gate that’s still open?

items.speaker: CHAE
items.text: Minho’s at a survey site this morning.

items.speaker: CHAE
items.text: I’ll send the address. Ask him what he can show you there.

items.speaker: CHAE
items.text: Ask him at the entrance. Keep out of the work lanes.

items.speaker: TAEO
items.text: I’m at the shop four to ten. Today and tomorrow.

items.speaker: NIB
items.text: Then ask when we need to leave.

items.speaker: MINHO
items.text: You can watch from this bay. Stay south of that barrier.

items.speaker: TAEO
items.text: We need to be back before four.

items.speaker: MINHO
items.text: We’ll be finished here before lunch.

items.speaker: NIB
items.text: I want to see the gate itself.

items.speaker: MINHO
items.text: From the bay. Once we’ve moved the station.

items.speaker: NIB
items.text: Where does it have to end?

items.speaker: MINHO
items.text: The low stand. By the radio table.

items.speaker: MINHO
items.text: The marked lane. Stay clear of the unloading.

items.speaker: NIB
items.text: Down to the south fence, along it, then in by the table.

items.speaker: NIB
items.text: It’s level. The porter fits outside the open door. The stand’s clear.

items.speaker: TAEO
items.text: Along the fence, then turn in at the table?

items.speaker: MINHO
items.text: Yes. Bring it round this side.

items.speaker: TAEO
items.text: I thought we’d be waiting for the van.

items.speaker: NIB
items.text: The van won’t fit there. The porter does.

items.speaker: MINHO
items.text: You can see it from here.

lines: You can see it from here.

items.speaker: NIB
items.text: That picture was taken in there?
